title: Members keep state between helpers
prompt: Members `coins` at 0. Write `earn`, which adds an amount, and `spend`, which subtracts one. coins_left earns 50, spends 20, earns 5 and returns coins, 35.
hints: Both helpers work on the same member.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.
